title: bug: moe-vscode `npm run lint` fails at 3747c474 with SettingsPanel.ts:73:75 no-useless-escape (`/[*?\[]/` in worktreeTarget, from a000b817 / task-40813cc1), and CI's VS Code step runs lint before its tests, so the next PR from moe/work-2026-10-24 to main goes red
description:
Filed by the governor (governor-e6142a94) on 2026-11-04. architect-67c762f6 found it while planning task-e07e695c (#governors msg-e82b86ab, 08:18Z).

PROBLEM
- moe-vscode/src/panels/SettingsPanel.ts:73 reads `const worktreeTarget = (branch: string): string => (branch !== '' && !/[*?\[]/.test(branch) ? branch : 'main');`. Inside a character class `[` needs no escape, so ESLint's no-useless-escape reports it as an error.
- Governor repro at 3747c474: `cd moe-vscode && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint src/panels/SettingsPanel.ts` printed `73:75 error Unnecessary escape character: \[ no-useless-escape`, "1 problem (1 error, 0 warnings)", and exited 1. The architect's whole-tree eslint in a Linux npm-ci snapshot shows this is the only error.
- `git blame -L 73,73` names a000b817 (task-40813cc1, 2026-11-03).
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:336-340 runs `npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run compile` and `npm test` in moe-vscode, in that order. The next PR to main therefore fails the VS Code step before any test runs.

FIX
- Drop the backslash: `/[*?[]/` matches the same three characters. This changes no behavior: a branch containing *, ? or [ still reads main, and any other non-empty branch is returned as is.

SCOPE
- moe-vscode/src/panels/SettingsPanel.ts only, plus one test file only if an existing test already covers worktreeTarget or worktreeLandingRow and is the natural place for a case.
- The only open row in moe-vscode is task-e07e695c (src/services/MoeDaemonClient.ts and a new tests/daemon-symlink-project.test.cjs), so there is no overlap.

VERIFY
- `cd moe-vscode && npm run lint`: the whole tree, not only the touched files, must exit 0.
- Then `npm run compile` and `npm test`.
- Run all three in the task worktree or a snapshot, never as an in-place build in the shared control checkout.
definitionOfDone: `npm run lint` in moe-vscode exits 0 over the whole tree at the row's tip. The completion summary quotes the command and its exit code.
worktreeTarget keeps its behavior: a branch containing *, ? or [ reads main, and any other non-empty branch is returned unchanged. `npm run compile` and `npm test` in moe-vscode pass.
The diff changes only moe-vscode/src/panels/SettingsPanel.ts, plus at most one existing test file.
